title: FurnitureFile
description: The JSON shape of one file in `data/furniture/`.

$schema.description:
Optional: the JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can check
it as you type (`"$schema": "../schema/furniture.schema.json"`).

Colour.description:
The colours a material can be drawn in. A short fixed list rather than
any colour at all, so every terminal can show them (decision D16).

oneOf.description: Doors, so they stand out from the walls around them.

blocks_sight.description:
It's tall enough to hide what's behind it, like a locker.
Optional: you can see over it.

colour.description: Optional: the colour to draw it in, instead of its material's.

description.description: A sentence or two for look mode.

glyph.description: The character the map draws on every tile it covers.

holds_ml.description:
How much it holds, in millilitres, if it's a container like a
locker. Optional: it holds nothing.

id.description: How maps refer to it, like `"stasis_chamber"`.

material.description: The id of the material it's mostly made of.

name.description: How it's shown to the player, like "stasis chamber".

size.description:
Its width and height in tiles, from 1 to 4, as it stands unturned:
`[2, 1]` is two tiles across and one down. Optional: `[1, 1]`.

walkable.description: You can walk through it, like a chair. Optional: it's in the way.
